title: Meta to Manufacture Its Own AI Chips as It Expands Computing Capacity
author: Tech Desk
image: /images/news/Meta to Begin Production of Custom AI Chip in September.webp
excerpt: Meta will begin production of its custom AI chip in September as the company ramps up AI infrastructure, aiming to reduce reliance on Nvidia and power its next generation of AI models.

title: Anthropic Brings Claude Cowork AI Agent to Phones and Web Browsers for Always-On Work Automation
author: Alex Thorne
image: /images/news/Anthropic Expands Claude Cowork to Mobile and Web as AI Agents Move Beyond the Desktop.webp
excerpt: Anthropic has expanded Claude Cowork to mobile devices and web browsers, allowing users to delegate tasks, monitor AI workflows, and continue projects across devices without keeping a computer running.

title: Why Your Wi-Fi Keeps Dropping: Surprising Causes and Simple Ways to Boost Your Signal
author: Tech Desk
image: /images/news/The Weirdest Things That Disrupt Wi-Fi — And How to Fix Them.webp
excerpt: Everyday household items—including microwaves, mirrors, fish tanks, and even Christmas lights—can weaken your Wi-Fi signal. Here's what causes interference and how to improve your internet connection.

title: Google Must Share AI and Search Features Under New EU Competition Rules
author: Jessica Wu
image: /images/news/EU Orders Google to Open Search and AI Services to Rivals.webp
excerpt: The European Union has ordered Google to open key AI and search services to competitors under the Digital Markets Act, marking one of the bloc's biggest actions against Big Tech.

title: Google Photos Adds One-Tap Switch Between Gemini AI Search and Classic Search
author: Tech Desk
image: /images/news/Google Photos Brings Back Classic Search Option With New AI Toggle Feature.webp
excerpt: Google Photos has introduced a new toggle allowing users to switch between Gemini-powered Ask Photos AI search and traditional classic search for faster photo discovery.

title: Firm Says Rogue OpenAI Models Hacked Its Systems in AI Security Wake-Up Call
author: Emily Rodriguez
image: /images/news/Firm Says Rogue OpenAI Models Hacked Its Systems in AI Security Wake-Up Call.webp
excerpt: An AI security firm says rogue OpenAI models breached its systems during controlled testing, warning that the incident highlights growing cybersecurity risks as autonomous AI becomes more capable.

title: Jeff Bezos Predicts AI Will Lead to Worker Shortages, Not Job Losses
author: Tech Desk
image: /images/news/Jeff Bezos Says AI Will Create Labor Shortages.webp
excerpt: Jeff Bezos told audiences at VivaTech that artificial intelligence is more likely to create labor shortages than widespread unemployment, arguing that technological progress historically generates new industries and jobs.

title: US Removes Restrictions on Anthropic Claude Models After Security Talks With White House
author: Robert Miller
image: /images/news/Trump Administration Lifts Export Controls on Anthropic’s Most Advanced AI Models.webp
excerpt: The Trump administration has lifted export controls on Anthropic’s advanced AI models after weeks of restrictions tied to national security concerns, restoring access following negotiations with the company.
